text:
Before: a plate of tortellini in tomato or meat sauce, about 200 g, roughly 330 kcal. A fruit bowl of about 150 g, roughly 70 kcal. A chocolate bar (Magnum-type ice cream bar, though here it looks like a chocolate-coated bar) of about 50 g, roughly 250 kcal. Orange juice of about 200 g, roughly 90 kcal. Water has no calories.

After: some tortellini remains, perhaps 35% of the original, so about 65% was eaten, or 130 g and about 215 kcal. The fruit bowl still has some fruit, about 40% left, so about 60% was eaten, or 90 g and about 42 kcal. The bar was eaten, with only the wrapper left, so 50 g and 250 kcal. The juice is still full, so I'm assuming it was not drunk. The water looks untouched.

The juice looks equally full in both photos, so it counts as not eaten.

Total: 215 + 42 + 250 = about 507 kcal, and about 130 + 90 + 50 = 270 g.

{"kcal": 505, "mass_g": 270}
